description: KindlingAI's exlr8 v2 release of Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini at revision 3037e66b, as pinned by KindlingAI's gr8 recipe: every routed expert of all 24 physical layers stored at the K2, K3 and K4 trellis widths (the serving width is chosen at load time: bit325, k4, bit225, bit250 or k2), dense, attention, router and vocabulary weights in BF16, a bundled 279 MB DFlash speculative drafter derived from incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2 (Apache-2.0), and per-TP index slices for one to four ranks. The vision tower's weights are in the pack, but the gr8 front end takes text only. Its card reports a mean KL of 0.015019 for bit325 and 0.010460 for k4 against BF16.
